description: US federal bills from Congress.gov (Library of Congress). Keyword search (q) runs over the 250 most recently updated bills of a Congress, since the API has no full-text search; each match gets its sponsor, status and latest action. A bill number (bill=hr1234-119) returns its cosponsor count, committees and up to 30 actions. Public domain. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

bill.description: A bill, e.g. hr1234-119 or s50-119 (type, number, Congress)

congress.description: Congress number 93 to the current one (119), default current

q.description: Words that must all appear in the bill title

name: congress
title: Congress
